verdict.rationale: Keycloak ships an official, first-party Admin CLI (kcadm.sh in the server distribution's bin directory). It supports scripted administration of realms, users, roles and clients, mirroring the Admin REST API. Server lifecycle commands such as start-dev are also part of the official tooling. missing for 10: evidence of agent-friendly CLI ergonomics (structured/JSON output, non-interactive auth guidance for AI workflows), in-depth CLI reference beyond a single doc mention, independent hands-on corroboration of kcadm usage.
